contents.content:
Railway Recruitment Board (RRB) has released a fresh notification for the post of Section Controller under Centralised Employment Notification No. CEN 03/2026. Those candidates who have been enrolled with RRB Section Controller CEN 03/2026 exam can apply online from 15/07/2026 to 14/08/2026.

Important Dates

Application Begins 15/07/2026
Last Date for Apply Online 14/08/2026
Pay Exam Fee Last Date 16/08/2026
Correction Date 17-26 August 2026
RRB Section Controller Exam Date As per Schedule
Admit Card Available Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : 500/-
  • SC / ST / Female  : 250/-
  • PH (Divyang) : 250/-
  • After Appear the Stage I Exam
  • UR / OBC / EWS Fee Refund : 400/-
  • SC / ST / PH / Female Refund : 250/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through E Challan or Net Banking

Age Limit as on 01/07/2026

  • Maximum Age : 33 Years
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per Railway RRB Section Controller CEN 03/2026 Recruitment Rules

Vacancy Details Total : 119 Post

Post Name Total Post RRB Section Controller Exam Eligibility
Railway RRB Section Controller Post 119 Bachelor Degree in Any Stream from Any Recognized University in India. More Eligibility Details Read the Notification.

  • Kindly Check and Collect the All Document - Eligibility, ID Proof, Address Details, Basic Details.

contents.content:
West Bengal Public Service Commission (WBPSC) is going to release a notification for the post of ICDS Supervisor along with Cook & Helper posts under the Department of Women & Child Development and Social Welfare, Govt of West Bengal. Those candidates who are waiting for WBPSC ICDS Application 2026 can check the post information, selection procedure, age limit, pay scale and all other information before applying.

Important Dates

Notification Release To Be Notified
Application Begins To Be Notified
Last Date for Apply Online To Be Notified
WBPSC ICDS Supervisor Exam Date As per Schedule
Admit Card Available Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General : 160/-
  • SC / ST (West Bengal) & PwBD : Exempted
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Online Mode Only
  • Fee Once Paid Will Not Be Refunded Under Any Circumstances

Age Limit

  • Supervisor Post : 18 to 39 Years (Expected)
  • Cook & Helper Post : 18 to 35 Years (Expected)
  • Age Relaxation Extra as per WBPSC ICDS Recruitment Rules (SC/ST – 5 Years, OBC-A/OBC-B – 3 Years, PwBD – as per Govt Norms)

Vacancy Details Total : 16000 Post (Expected)

Post Name Total Post WBPSC ICDS Recruitment Eligibility
